title: The legend of Brahmadatta
introduction: Daughters of Kushanaabha report about the Air-god's mischief. Pleased at their behaviour Kushanaabha thinks and arranges for their marriage with Brahmadatta, a saintly king. After the marriage, by the touch of hand of Brahmadatta the girls are rid of their misshapen bodies and they again become great beauties.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 33rd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कुशनाभस्य धीमतः |
शिरोभिश्चरणौ स्पृष्ट्वा कन्याशतमभाषत
verses.iast:
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ |
śirobhiḥ caraṇau spṛṣṭvā kanyā śatam abhāṣata
verses.translation: On hearing that sentence of scholarly Kushanaabha those hundred girls touched his feet with their foreheads and spoke to him.

verses.devanagari:
वायुः सर्वात्मको राजन् प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति |
अशुभं मार्गमास्थाय न धर्मं प्रत्यवेक्षते
verses.iast:
vāyuḥ sarvātmako rājan pradharṣayitum icchati |
aśubham mārgam āsthāya na dharmam pratyavekṣate
verses.translation: " 'The all-pervasive Air-god desired to dishonour us, oh, king, resorting to improper approach and overlooking virtuous conduct.

glosses.meaning: not, auspicious, path - improper approach, resorting to
to highly, maltreat [dishonour us,] he desired to
virtuous conduct of girls, not, towards, seeing - overlooking.

verses.devanagari:
पितृमत्यः स्म भद्रं ते स्वच्छन्दे न वयं स्थिताः |
पितरं नो वृणीष्व त्वं यदि नो दास्यते तव
verses.iast:
pitṛmatyaḥ sma bhadram te svacchande na vayam sthitāḥ |
pitaram no vṛṇīṣva tvam yadi no dāsyate tava
verses.translation: " 'Our father is there and we are not independent, you be safe, hence oh, Air-god, you may request our father to know whether he gives us to you or not.' Thus we have told the Air-god, but...

glosses.meaning: we, those that have a father [father dependent,] we are there
our, own way, not [not independent,] we are
you, with our, father, may request.

verses.devanagari:
तेन पापानुबन्धेन वचनं न प्रतीच्छता |
एवं ब्रुवंत्यः सर्वाः स्म वायुनाभिहता भृषम्
verses.iast:
tena pāpa anubandhena vacanam na pratīcchatā |
evam bruvantyaḥ sarvāḥ sma vāyunā abhihatā bhṛṣam
verses.translation: " 'Though we all have spoken to him thus, that Air-god who is bound by venality refused to take notice of our words and he has harmed us a lot.' Thus those girls informed their father.
notes: Since then, because the Wind-God bent / The damsels' forms for punishment, / That royal town is known to fame / By Kanyakubja's borrowed name. That is, the City of the Bent Virgins, the modern Kanauj or Canouge - Griffith.

glosses.meaning: in reply, bearing in mind - one who refused to take notice

verses.devanagari:
तासां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा परमधार्मिकः |
प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः कन्याशतमनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
tāsām tu vacanam śrutvā rājā parama dhārmikaḥ |
pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ kanyā śatam anuttamam
verses.translation: On listening their words that highly virtuous and highly resplendent king spoke to the hundred girls with unsurpassed virtue.

glosses.meaning: to un, surpassing, to girls, hundred, said.

verses.devanagari:
क्षान्तं क्षमावतां पुत्र्यः कर्तव्यं सुमहत्कृतम् |
ऐकमत्यमुपागम्य कुलं चावेक्षितं मम
verses.iast:
kṣāntam kṣamāvatām putryaḥ kartavyam sumahat kṛtam |
aikamatyam upāgaṃya kulam ca āvekṣitam mama
verses.translation: " 'Forgiving is the duty of imperturbable and you have done it. Excellent. Oh, daughters, coursing through your unity my family's prestige is also kept up.

glosses.meaning: those that have self-control - imperturbability, their duty, is forgiving
that is done - you have done it
[this is] very, excellent [deed you have done]

verses.devanagari:
अलंकारो हि नारीणां क्षमा तु पुरुषस्य वा |
दुष्करं तच्च वै क्षान्तं त्रिदशेषु विशेषतः
यादृशी वः क्षमा पुत्र्यः सर्वासामविशेषतः |
verses.iast:
alaṅkāro hi nārīṇām kṣamā tu puruṣasya vā |
duṣkaram tat ca vai kṣāntam tridaśeṣu viśeṣataḥ
yādṛśīḥ vaḥ kṣamā putryaḥ sarvāsām aviśeṣataḥ |
verses.translation: " 'Forgiveness is an adornment to women, as a matter of fact, even for men, and this matter called 'forgiving' that which is there, it is an impracticable affair. That too, in respect of divinities. And the kind of forgiveness you all possess uniformly, that is further laudable.
notes: This also means: 'though you possess excellent aspects and persona alike celestials, viz., apsara-s, for you are the children of celestial / apsara Ghritachi... you have forgiven Air-god, without submitting yourselves to bodily pleasures of humans.'

glosses.meaning: forgiveness, adornment, as a matter of fact
that is, not, practicable, also, verily

verses.devanagari:
क्षमा दानं क्षमा सत्यं क्षमा यज्ञश्च पुत्रिकाः
क्षमा यशः क्षमा धर्मः क्षमायां विष्ठितं जगत् |
verses.iast:
kṣamā dānam kṣamā satyam kṣamā yajñaḥ ca putrikāḥ
kṣamā yaśaḥ kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamāyām viṣṭhitam jagat |
verses.translation: " 'Grace is altruism, grace is ritualism, oh, my daughters, grace is glory, grace is virtue, and this universe is verily abiding in graciousness alone for grace itself is the truth, isn't it!' Thus king Kushanaabha said to his daughters and sent them away.

glosses.meaning: in graciousness, universe is, verily, abiding.

verses.devanagari:
विसृज्य कन्याः काकुत्स्थ राजा त्रिदशविक्रमः
मंत्रज्ञो मंत्रयामास प्रदानं सह मंत्रिभिः |
देशे काले च कर्तव्यं सदृशे प्रतिपादनम्
verses.iast:
visṛjya kanyāḥ kākutstha rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ
mantrajño mantrayāmāsa pradānam saha mantribhiḥ |
deśe kāle ca kartavyam sadṛśe pratipādanam
verses.translation: "On leaving those girls, oh, Rama, that king whose valour matches that of gods and who is an expert in thinking strategies started to think with his ministers on the topics like, as to how his daughters are to be espoused to, to which country they are to be sent, at which time marriage shall happen, and to which matching bridegroom the marriage is to be proposed, and so on." Thus Vishvamitra continued his narration.

glosses.meaning: in which country, at which time
[marriage] proposals, is to be done - on such topics he discussed with ministers.

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु चूली नाम महाद्युतिः |
ऊर्ध्वरेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मं तप उपागमत्
verses.iast:
etasmin eva kāle tu cūlī nāma mahādyutiḥ |
ūrdhva retāḥ śubhācāro brāhmam tapa upāgamat
verses.translation: During that time a great-resplendent sage named Cuulii is there, who is propitious in his demeanour and who holds his semen upward, and who has achieved high ascetic practise strictly according to Vedic canons.
notes: The ūrthva retaḥ is that the yogi-s of a very high practice of pure yoga called haṭha yoga, will hold their semen un-ejaculated by use or misuse, and they make it course towards their heads through the six-plexuses of human body. This type of practice is to enrich their mental and physical glow and they will have a divine aura around them.

glosses.meaning: with upward, semen - meaning whose semen is not lost
Vedic, asceticism - one who has ascesis strict to Vedic canons

verses.devanagari:
तपस्यन्तमृषिं तत्र गंधर्वी पर्युपासते |
सोमदा नाम भद्रं ते ऊर्मिलातनया तदा
verses.iast:
tapasyantam ṛṣim tatra gandharvī paryupāsate |
somadā nāma bhadram te ūrmilā tanayā tadā
verses.translation: "While that sage is in the practise of asceticism a celestial female served him at the place of his ascesis, safety be with you oh, Rama, she is Somada by her name, the daughter of Urmila.

glosses.meaning: at the place of ascesis, while practising, sage is
Somada, named, a gandharva / celestial female

verses.devanagari:
सा च तं प्रणता भूत्वा शुश्रूषणपरायणा |
उवास काले धर्मिष्ठा तस्यास्तुष्टोऽभवद् गुरुः
verses.iast:
sā ca tam praṇatā bhūtvā śuśrūṣaṇa parāyaṇā |
uvāsa kāle dharmiṣṭhā tasyāḥ tuṣṭo abhavat guruḥ
verses.translation: "Even she is obedient in his respect, and dedicating herself in ministering to him she stayed there righteously. After some time that sage Cuulii has become satisfied with her service.

verses.devanagari:
स च तां कालयोगेन प्रोवाच रघुनंदन |
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते किं करोमि तव प्रियम्
verses.iast:
sa ca tām kāla yogena provāca raghu nandana |
parituṣṭo asmi bhadram te kim karomi tava priyam
verses.translation: "When her service is fructified, oh, Rama, that sage benevolently spoke to her saying, 'I am perfectly pleased with your service, let good betide you, what cherish of yours I have to fulfil.'

glosses.meaning: time, by chance of - when her service is fructified
your, what, cherish, I can do - I have to fulfil.

verses.devanagari:
परितुष्टं मुनिं ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुरस्वरा |
उवाच परमप्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्यकोविदम्
verses.iast:
parituṣṭam munim jñātvā gandharvī madhura svaram |
uvāca parama prītā vākyajñā vākya kovidam
verses.translation: "Perceiving that the sage is contented that female celestial Soamda who is aware of making good sentences is highly delighted and spoke with her melodious voice to that pedantic sage.

glosses.meaning: sentence making, she who is aware of
sentence making, to expert - pedantic sage

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्म्या समुदितो ब्राह्म्या ब्रह्मभूतो महातपाः |
ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तं पुत्रमिच्छामि धार्मिकम्
verses.iast:
lakṣṃyā samudito brāhṃyā brahma bhūto mahātapāḥ |
brāhmeṇa tapasā yuk{}tam putram icchāmi dhārmikam
verses.translation: " 'Vedic splendour is flourishing in you when you have become one with Brahma, oh, supreme ascetic, I may please be endowed with a righteous son whose ascetic spirituality may embody the spirituality enunciated in Veda-s.

glosses.meaning: pertaining to Brahma [Vedic practises,] splendour, is on the rise - flourishing
with Brahma's [spirituality of Veda-s,] ascetic [spirituality,] along with - embodied with
righteous, son, I wish to have - I may be endowed with.

verses.devanagari:
अपतिश्चास्मि भद्रं ते भार्या चास्मि न कस्यचित् |
ब्राह्मेणोपगतायाश्च दातुमर्हसि मे सुतम्
verses.iast:
apatiḥ ca asmi bhadram te bhāryā ca asmi na kasyacit |
brāhmeṇa upagatāyāḥ ca dātum arhasi me sutam
verses.translation: " 'I am unmarried and nobody's wife, safe you be, and as I took shelter under your kindness it will be apt of you to endow me a son with your faculty of asceticism.' So said Somada to sage Cuulii.

glosses.meaning: to anyone, wife, not, I am
nearby, arrived - took shelter under you
a son, to endow, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
तस्याः प्रसन्नो ब्रह्मर्षिर्ददौ ब्राह्ममनुत्तमम् |
ब्रह्मदत्त इति ख्यातं मानसं चूलिनः सुतम्
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ prasanno brahmarṣir dadau brāhmam anuttamam |
brahmadatta iti khyātam mānasam cūlinaḥ sutam
verses.translation: "That Brahma-sage Cuulina benignantly bestowed her with a unique and Brahma-like son who is renowned as Brahmadatta, as well as his own brainchild.
notes: The word 'cuulinaH' also read as Cuulina, another name for this sage Cuuli.

glosses.meaning: of her, one who became benignant, Brahma-sage

verses.devanagari:
स राजा ब्रह्मदत्तस्तु पुरीमध्यवसत्तदा |
कांपिल्यां परया लक्ष्म्या देवराजो यथा दिवम्
verses.iast:
sa rājā brahmadattaḥ tu purīm adhyavasat tadā |
kāmpilyām parayā lakṣṃyā devarājo yathā divam
verses.translation: "King Brahmadatta endued with superb grandeur ruled from a city called Kaampilya as with Indra ruling the heaven.

glosses.meaning: Brahmadatta, he that, king, for his part
god's, king, Indra, heaven, as with
endued with superb, grandeur, presided - ruled.

verses.devanagari:
स बुद्धिं कृतवान् राजा कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः |
ब्रह्मदत्ताय काकुत्स्थ दातुं कन्याशतं तदा
verses.iast:
sa buddhim kṛtavān rājā kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ |
brahmadattāya kākutstha dātum kanyā śatam tadā
verses.translation: "The most righteous king Kushanaabha then made up his mind, oh, Rama of Kakutstha, to espouse his hundred daughters to Brahmadatta.

glosses.meaning: to Brahmadatta, to give - to espouse

verses.devanagari:
तमाहूय महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तं महीपतिः |
ददौ कन्याशतं राजा सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना
verses.iast:
tam āhūya mahātejā brahmadattam mahīpatiḥ |
dadau kanyā śatam rājā suprītena antarātmanā
verses.translation: "Inviting Brahmadatta that great-resplendent lord of the land, namely the king Kushanaabha, married his hundred daughters to him, pleasing highly in his heart of hearts.

glosses.meaning: great-resplendent, lord of land, king - Kushanaabha
him that, Brahmadatta, on calling - inviting
with highly, pleased, heart of hearts

verses.devanagari:
यथाक्रमम् ततः पाणीन् जग्राह रघुनंदन |
ब्रह्मदत्तो महीपालस्तासां देवपतिर्यथा
verses.iast:
yathā kramam tataḥ pāṇim jagrāha raghunandana |
brahmadatto mahīpālaḥ tāsām devapatir yathā
verses.translation: "As with the tradition of marriage king Brahmadatta who vies with lord of gods, namely Indra, in succession took the palm of each of the hundred girls into his palm.

glosses.meaning: gods, lord - Indra, who vies with
their, palm, caught - received each of their palm into his hand, as per the custom of marriage.

verses.devanagari:
स्पृष्टमात्रे ततः पाणौ विकुब्जा विगतज्वराः |
युक्ताः परमया लक्ष्म्या बभुः कन्याः शतं तदा
verses.iast:
spṛṣṭa mātre tataḥ pāṇau vikub.hjā vigata jvarāḥ |
yuk{}tāḥ paramayā lakṣṃyā babhau kanyā śatam tadā
verses.translation: "By mere touch of hand of Brahmadatta alone, their misshape and desperation are evanished, and all of those hundred maidens beamed bright as they are retouched with utmost elegance.

glosses.meaning: with utmost, elegance, along with [retouched with]

verses.devanagari:
स दृष्ट्वा वायुना मुक्ताः कुशनाभो महीपतिः |
बभूव परमप्रीतो हर्षं लेभे पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā vāyunā muk{}tāḥ kuśanābho mahīpatiḥ |
babhūva parama prīto harṣam lebhe punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: "On seeing his daughters getting release from the effect of Air-god Kushanaabha became highly joyful, and he took great delight time and again as and when he looked at them.

glosses.meaning: again, again, delight, he took - in seeing his daughters restored to originality.

verses.devanagari:
कृतोद्वाहं तु राजानं ब्रह्मदत्तं महीपतिः |
सदारं प्रेषयामास सोपाध्यायगणं तदा
verses.iast:
kṛta udvāham tu rājānam brahmadattam mahīpatiḥ |
sadāram preṣayāmāsa sa upādhyāya gaṇam tadā
verses.translation: "Later when the marriage is complete king Kushanaabha bade farewell to king Brahmadatta along with his wives, his own hundred daughters, and along with the groups of religious teachers.

glosses.meaning: one who has finished, marriage - when marriage is over

verses.devanagari:
सोमदापि सुतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्य सदृशीं क्रियाम् |
यथान्यायं च गन्धर्वी स्नुषास्ताः प्रत्यनंदत |
स्पृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा च ताः कन्याः कुशनाभं प्रशस्य च
verses.iast:
somadā api sutam dṛṣṭvā putrasya sadṛśīm kriyām |
yathā nyāyam ca gandharvī snuṣāḥ tāḥ pratyanandata |
spṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca tāḥ kanyāḥ kuśanābham praśasya ca
verses.translation: "Somada, the celestial female and the mother of Brahmadatta, is gladdened to see her son Brahmadatta, for the worthwhile deed done by him in removing the blemish caused by the Air-god to the girls, or in bringing those worthwhile girls as her daughter-in-laws. She is further gladdened while her feet are traditionally and repeatedly touched by a hundred daughter-in-laws in succession, coupled with her own raising of each of the daughter-in-law to embrace for a hundred times. Thus Somada has gone on caressing each of her hundred daughter-in-laws, and in doing so she is gladdened to do so over and over again, she is gladdened. She thus praised Kushanaabha for giving his gemlike daughters as her daughter-in-laws and blessed the daughter-in-laws.

glosses.meaning: those, daughter-in-laws, towards, gladdened - or - blessed them.
